params.body:
## Why

On staging the price step of the vehicle sheet refused to save. Shane filled in "Collega
Stocklistdealer prijs Samen Sterk" (trade_price) with 9000, saved, got "Nog 1 verplicht veld niet
ingevuld: Eindklant", and after a reload the 9000 was gone. The red warning "Verkoopprijs en
verkoopprijs stocklist moeten ingevuld zijn om het voertuig op de Stocklist te plaatsen" kept
standing under the field he had just filled in.

Two defects, one of which loses typed data. The acceptance test runs today, so the diff is kept
narrow: nothing changes about WHEN a vehicle may go on the Stocklist, only about what gets saved
and what the sheet says.

## Where the message comes from

`vehicle.prices_must_be_filled_for_stocklist` (resources/lang/{nl,fr,de}/vehicle.php) is rendered in
three places: `ownstock/_tabs/prices.blade.php` (shared by the classic form and the Livewire sheet),
`ownstock/_tabs/dates.blade.php` (classic only) and as a hint under the Stocklist checkbox in
`livewire/vehicle-form.blade.php`. Classic toggles it from jQuery (`vehicle.onStock()` and the
`#retail_price, #trade_price` change handler in create/edit); the Livewire sheet re-renders it on
every round trip.

## What was wrong

1. **The save was refused, so nothing was stored.** `export_price` ("minimumbedrag biedingen",
   labelled Eindklant) is `required` in `VehicleRequest::rulesFor` and always was: the rule is
   unchanged since `cutover-baseline`. The sheet shows the field empty as soon as it is 0 (a 0 reads
   as an amount), and the column is `NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`, so nearly every vehicle carries a 0 there.
   The classic door normalises an empty amount back to 0 in `VehicleRequest::prepareForValidation`
   (via `OwnStockService::normaliseAmounts`), but the Livewire door validates the component
   PROPERTIES and never passed that point. Result: every vehicle without a minimum bid amount was
   refused, and everything typed on that step was lost because nothing was written at all.
2. **The warning was decided from the database row.** The block in `prices.blade.php` read
   `$vehicle->trade_price` / `$vehicle->retail_price` while the fields above it are the Livewire
   properties. The row is only written on save, so the warning stayed put under a field that was
   just filled in, and would have kept lying even if the save had gone through.
3. **The hint under the Stocklist checkbox blamed the prices** whenever the gate was closed, also
   when the real reason was "op stock" or "technisch klaar".
4. **Classic lied the other way.** `parseFloat('')` is `NaN`, and `NaN <= 0` is false, so an empty
   price field made the warning disappear, which is the worse direction.

## What changed

- `VehicleForm::prepareForValidation()` runs the same `OwnStockService::normaliseAmounts()` the
  classic door already uses, so an empty amount is validated as the 0 it is. One normalisation, one
  place.
- `prices.blade.php` reads the typed values on the Livewire sheet and the row in the classic form, so
  the warning follows the fields and disappears (and returns) without a reload.
- The checkbox hint only names the prices when a price is really what is missing.
- `vehicle.priceAmount()` in `resources/js/vehicle/vehicle.js` parses a typed amount and counts empty
  as missing; the two classic handlers use it.

The Stocklist gate itself (`canBeOnStocklist`: op stock + technisch klaar + a trade price) is
untouched.

## Checked

- New `tests/Feature/VehiclePriceWarningTest.php`: a typed trade price is stored on a vehicle without
  a minimum bid; a refused save keeps what was typed and names the blocking field; the warning
  follows the fields over Livewire updates without a reload; the gate still needs a trade price and
  stays quiet about prices when the reason is another one. Mutation-checked: reverting either fix
  makes the matching test fail.
- `php artisan test --filter='VehicleForm|Vehicle|Price|OwnStock|SmokeTest'` green (20 tests, 697
  assertions), plus `BuildContract`, `StylesheetSyntax`, `UiApiUsage`, `RulesCoverage`.
- `php artisan view:cache` plus `php -l` over every compiled view; `npm run build`.
params.title: Vehicle sheet: the price warning follows the fields
